name: Venerable Jakov (James) of Stromynsk
life: The Monk Jakov (James) of Stromynsk was a disciple of the Monk Sergei of Radonezh (commemorated September 25). He was hegumen of the Stromynsk monastery in the Name of the Life-originating Trinity. The Monk Sergei himself founded this monastery in 1380 at the request of GreatPrince Dimitrii Donskoi (1363-1389) in memory of the victory of Kulikovo Pole (Field). At this monastery there was as hegumen also the Monk Savva of Svenigorod (1381-1392, commemorated December 3). The Monk Jakov was buried in the monastery church.
